note: Submodule of mailchimp_transactional. Two admin report pages sourced from the external Mailchimp Transactional API: dashboard (admin/reports/mailchimp_transactional, ReportsController::dashboard, getTagsAllTimeSeries volume chart) and account summary (admin/reports/mailchimp_transactional/summary, getUser). Service mailchimp_transactional_reports.service (ReportsService) caches via cache.mailchimp_transactional. No config entity or settings. The DEFINED permission is 'view mailchimp transactional reports' (with spaces); NOTE the route _permission requirement is misspelled 'view mailchimp_transactional reports' (underscore), so by default only user 1 reaches the pages. Because report DATA is external API, all medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in local role/permission config: setup/reset write known role grants of the defined permission, verify/introspection read them back.

evals.prompt: What does the mailchimp_transactional_reports submodule add, and at what admin path is its dashboard?
evals.expected_output: It adds admin report pages under Reports: a dashboard at admin/reports/mailchimp_transactional charting sent/bounced/rejected volume (from the API getTagsAllTimeSeries), and an account summary at admin/reports/mailchimp_transactional/summary (from getUser). Data comes from the Mailchimp Transactional API.

evals.prompt: Which permission does mailchimp_transactional_reports define to gate its report pages, and is there anything unusual about how the routes reference it?
evals.expected_output: The defined permission is 'view mailchimp transactional reports' (restricted). Note the routes' _permission requirement is written 'view mailchimp_transactional reports' (with an underscore), which does not match the defined permission, so by default only user 1 can reach the pages until reconciled.

evals.prompt: Where does the data on the mailchimp_transactional_reports dashboard come from, and how is it kept from hammering the source?
evals.expected_output: All report data is fetched from the external Mailchimp Transactional API via mailchimp_transactional_reports.service (ReportsService), which wraps the base module's API client; results are cached in the cache.mailchimp_transactional bin to avoid repeated API calls.

evals.prompt: On this site, one role has been granted access to the Mailchimp Transactional reports and another has not. Inspect the live role/permission configuration and tell me which role can view the Mailchimp Transactional reports.
evals.expected_output: Role mtr_a has the 'view mailchimp transactional reports' permission (mtr_b does not), so mtr_a can view the reports.

evals.prompt: Inspect the permissions granted to the role 'mtr_a' on this site and give the exact machine name of the Mailchimp Transactional reports permission it holds.
evals.expected_output: Role mtr_a holds the permission 'view mailchimp transactional reports' (the machine name defined by mailchimp_transactional_reports).

evals.prompt: There is a role 'mtr_task' on this site that should be able to see the Mailchimp Transactional reporting pages. Grant that role the permission that the mailchimp_transactional_reports module defines for viewing reports, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Role mtr_task is granted 'view mailchimp transactional reports' (e.g. drush role:perm:add mtr_task 'view mailchimp transactional reports').

evals.prompt: I want a new user role called 'mtr_new' whose only special power is being able to view the Mailchimp Transactional email reports. Create that role and give it the right permission, on the live site.
evals.expected_output: A role with id 'mtr_new' exists and has the 'view mailchimp transactional reports' permission granted.
